title: A single-cell and spatial RNA-seq database for Alzheimer's disease (ssREAD)
summary: Resource paper introducing ssREAD, a database for Alzheimer-related single-cell, single-nucleus, and spatial transcriptomics datasets. It emphasizes dataset curation, metadata annotation, usability, and an analysis suite for clustering, differential expression, marker genes, regulons, and spatial deconvolution.
full_text: The paper includes Alzheimer disease biological examples, but its primary contribution is a reusable database and analysis resource that aggregates datasets and exposes workflows for exploration. Disease biology is demonstrated through the resource rather than being the central new claim.
gold_slot_rationale: Labeled methods because the primary contribution is a reusable curated database and analysis resource, not a new causal disease-biology claim.

title: ClinVar: public archive of interpretations of clinically relevant variants
summary: Database/resource paper describing ClinVar as a public archive for submitted interpretations of variant clinical significance, supporting evidence, accessioning, aggregation, standards, and programmatic access.
full_text: The paper concerns the structure, submission model, standards, access, and maintenance of a variant-interpretation archive. Clinical and genetic terms are central to the resource's domain, but the contribution is the informatics archive itself.
gold_slot_rationale: Labeled methods because the contribution is a public data archive and informatics resource for variant interpretations.

title: The Gene Ontology knowledgebase in 2023
summary: Resource paper describing the Gene Ontology knowledgebase, including structured vocabularies, gene product annotations, updates, tools, and guidance for computational use of gene function data.
full_text: The paper's main contribution is maintenance and description of a standardized knowledgebase used for functional interpretation and computational analysis. It is not a primary mechanistic study of one pathway or disease.
gold_slot_rationale: Labeled methods because the contribution is a standardized gene-function knowledgebase and analysis resource.

title: Open Targets Platform: supporting systematic drug-target identification and prioritisation
summary: Database/platform paper describing Open Targets as a resource integrating target, disease, phenotype, drug, genetic, pathway, expression, text-mining, and animal-model evidence to support drug target identification and prioritization.
full_text: The paper is about the platform data model, evidence integration, scoring, curation, and programmatic/user access. Drug discovery and disease biology are use cases; the contribution is an informatics resource.
gold_slot_rationale: Labeled methods because the main contribution is an integrated platform/resource for target-disease evidence and prioritization.

title: Single-cell multiregion dissection of Alzheimer's disease
summary: Single-nucleus multi-region atlas study of post-mortem human brain samples across Alzheimer disease progression. It profiles more than one million nuclei across brain regions and identifies cell types, gene programs, vulnerability, response, and resilience patterns in Alzheimer pathology.
full_text: The paper provides an online resource, but the central scientific contribution is biological interpretation of AD progression across brain regions, neuronal and glial subtype changes, pathology-associated gene programs, and mechanisms of vulnerability and resilience.
gold_slot_rationale: Labeled mechanism because the resource is primarily used to make disease-biology claims about cell states, vulnerability, response, and resilience.

title: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis of Alzheimer's disease
summary: Single-nucleus transcriptomic study of Alzheimer disease brain tissue that identifies cell-type-specific transcriptional changes, disease-associated subpopulations, sex-specific responses, and associations with pathological and cognitive measures.
full_text: The study generates a single-cell dataset, but the center of gravity is interpreting Alzheimer disease cellular states and dysregulated biological programs across neuronal and glial cell types.
gold_slot_rationale: Labeled mechanism because the main contribution is disease-biology interpretation of cell-type-specific transcriptional programs, not resource curation.

title: Single-cell map of diverse immune phenotypes in the breast tumor microenvironment
summary: Single-cell RNA-seq study mapping immune phenotypes in breast tumors. It characterizes tumor-infiltrating immune cell states, diversity, activation and exhaustion programs, and relationships to the tumor microenvironment.
full_text: The paper creates a map, but the primary contribution is biological interpretation of immune-cell states and tumor-microenvironment programs that may promote or oppose tumor progression.
gold_slot_rationale: Labeled mechanism because the map is used to characterize tumor immune biology rather than to introduce a reusable database or reporting standard.

title: A molecular single-cell lung atlas of lethal COVID-19
summary: Single-cell lung atlas study using autopsy lung tissue from lethal COVID-19 and control samples. It identifies altered epithelial, endothelial, fibroblast, and immune-cell states and pathological circuits associated with severe lung disease.
full_text: Although the title says atlas, the paper's center of gravity is mechanistic disease interpretation: cellular dysregulation, tissue remodeling, inflammatory circuits, and pathological programs in lethal COVID-19 lungs.
gold_slot_rationale: Labeled mechanism because the atlas supports causal disease-biology interpretation of pathological cell states and circuits.
